title: Herald of Free Enterprise: open bow doors, vehicle-deck flooding, and ro-ro management/procedure failure
summary: Herald of Free Enterprise is encoded as a ro-ro watertight-integrity and management/procedure case: the ferry sailed with inner and outer bow doors open, water entered the vehicle deck, free-surface instability developed rapidly, and the formal investigation foregrounded not only individual omissions but a defective operating system and failed procedural enforcement.
